commands.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,os
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/rtk/history.db")+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
r=list(c.execute("select input_tokens,output_tokens,saved_tokens from commands order by saved_tokens desc"))
t=sum(x[2] for x in r); s=lambda n:sum(x[2] for x in r[:n])/t
cap,pre=7500,500
seen=lambda n: n if n<=cap else pre
d=[seen(i)-seen(o) for i,o,_ in r]
pos=sum(x for x in d if x>0); neg=-sum(x for x in d if x<0); net=pos-neg
over=sum(1 for i,_,_ in r if i>cap)
print("rows",len(r),"saved",t,"| top 1/10/100: %.1f%%/%.1f%%/%.1f%%"%(100*s(1),100*s(10),100*s(100)))
print("client-visible model (<=7500 inline, else 500 preview): avoided",pos,"added",neg,"net",net,"(%.2f%% of saved); raw over limit:"%(100*net/t),over)
assert s(10)>0.5 and 0<net<0.05*t
print("asserted: top 10 > 50% of saved; net client-visible difference > 0 and < 5% of saved")
PY
